newsitem.title: USA: Northern trusts file $250 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: Northern trusts file $250 mln preferred.

text.p: Three business trusts formed by Northern Trust Corp filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in preferred securities, series A.
The trusts, known as NTC Capital I, NTC Capital II and NTC Capital III, will use proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Northern Trust Corp.
The corporation intends to add the proceeds from the sale of the debentures to its general corporate funds and will be used for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
The preferred securities, Series A, have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred security, the filing said.

As of Sept 30, 1996, the corporation, based in Chicago, was the second largest bank holding company headquartered in Illinois and the 34th largest in the United States, based on consolidated total assets of $21.4 billion on that date.
